principles: Preserve reviewer evidence meaning: PLAN scope review remains a PLAN gate artifact.
Use separate later-phase acknowledgement rather than overloading scope_check_save.
Prefer mechanical command-policy regression tests over prose-only closure.
Keep parked backlog closure narrow and unrelated to authority evidence work.
drivers: scope_check_save is currently gate evidence consumed by story_review in PLAN.
DEV/REVIEW already expose scope_contract_acknowledge for explicit later-phase scope changes.
The story is low-priority maintenance and should not introduce new lifecycle semantics unless necessary.

options.name: keep-plan-only-and-document-ack-path
pros: Uses already implemented DEV/REVIEW acknowledgement mechanism
cons: Does not create a new later-phase reviewer signed scope-check artifact

options.name: extend-scope-check-save-to-dev-review
pros: Lets scope-plan reviewer write the same artifact after rollback
cons: Blurs PLAN gate evidence with later-phase evidence
Risks stale reviewer signatures and weaker phase boundary

options.name: new-later-phase-scope-check-command
pros: Could provide a distinct signed artifact
cons: More product/design work than this low backlog needs

rationale: Keep scope_check_save as PLAN-only signed reviewer evidence, and close the later-phase gap by documenting and testing the existing scope_contract_acknowledge path for DEV/REVIEW.

preMortem.scenario: scope_check_save accidentally becomes legal outside PLAN
preMortem.trigger: Developer broadens allowedPhases while fixing the backlog
preMortem.consequence: PLAN scope reviewer evidence loses clear phase meaning
preMortem.mitigation: Add command-policy test asserting scope_check_save remains PLAN-only

preMortem.trigger: Docs say scope changes are okay without naming scope_contract_acknowledge
preMortem.consequence: Agents may rely on natural-language pass instead of structured ack
preMortem.mitigation: Document scope_contract_acknowledge as the DEV/REVIEW path and test its allowed phases

preMortem.scenario: Story expands into unrelated authority or worktree cleanup
preMortem.trigger: Parked backlogs are treated as a batch
preMortem.consequence: Review surface grows and B-da5b/B-4622 responsibilities blur
preMortem.mitigation: Touch only story-lifecycle docs and command-policy regression tests for B-4622
